column8: www.ibm.com/able/about.html is IBM's accessibility sub-section About page, not the main corporate About/values page. It covers 2019 only of the missing years. No canonical About/values path confirmed for 2016–2018.

Regional pages (UAE /ae/en, China /cn/zh, Japan /jp/ja) used because no canonical corporate About page (corporate.thermofisher.com/en/about-us.html or www.thermofisher.com/us/en/home/about-us.html) returned archive coverage for the missing years.

Sub-section page within the /about hierarchy (accolades listings); the canonical pfizer.com/about page has no archive snapshots for 2018–2020. No broader About/values page was found with those years in the archive.

amazon.jobs is Amazon's careers/jobs sub-domain; the canonical aboutamazon.com only begins in 2018. These pages (Working at Amazon and Leadership Principles) are About/values-adjacent pages found on the jobs site, as no corporate About host has archive coverage for 2016-2017.

Sub-brand aviation section About page; no canonical corporate About/values page found on corporate.exxonmobil.com or about.exxonmobil.com (both empty in archive). The main www.exxonmobil.com/ap-english/about.aspx only covers 2016. Aviation sub-pages are the best available for missing years.
